name: int-practice-helper
description: Answer supported practice questions through a local Chrome extension and MCP bridge without an API key.

interface.shortDescription: Answer practice questions through a fast local browser bridge.
interface.longDescription: Reads text and image questions from supported signed-in practice pages through a local Chrome extension, or completes an explicitly requested subject, using the active Codex model without an external model API.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect the current supported practice page and help me with the questions I request.
